achievements.name: False Knight
achievements.detail: Defeat the False Knight in the Forgotten Crossroads.

achievements.name: Hornet Protector
achievements.detail: Defeat Hornet in Greenpath and claim the Mothwing Cloak.

achievements.name: Mantis Claw
achievements.detail: Pick up the Mantis Claw in the Mantis Village.

achievements.name: Mantis Lords
achievements.detail: Defeat the Mantis Lords beneath the Mantis Village.

achievements.name: Soul Master
achievements.detail: Defeat the Soul Master in the Soul Sanctum.

achievements.name: Crystal Heart
achievements.detail: Reach the far side of Crystal Peak and take the Crystal Heart.

achievements.name: Dream Nail
achievements.detail: Meet the Seer in the Resting Grounds and receive the Dream Nail.

achievements.name: Monarch Wings
achievements.detail: Defeat the Broken Vessel in the Ancient Basin and take the Monarch Wings.

achievements.name: Watcher Knights
achievements.detail: Defeat the Watcher Knights in the City of Tears.

achievements.name: Shade Cloak
achievements.detail: Wait in the void basin at the bottom of the Abyss until the Shade Cloak forms.

achievements.name: Trial of the Fool
achievements.detail: Clear the Trial of the Fool in the Colosseum of Fools.

achievements.name: The Hollow Knight
achievements.detail: Defeat the Hollow Knight inside the Black Egg Temple.

achievements.name: Dream No More
achievements.detail: Win the final dream battle reached through the Black Egg Temple.
